title: Why does a gas-fired furnace waste-heat exchanger also need cold air?
summary: Review waste-heat recovery together with heat-exchanger protection. Two Suneng gas-fired bogie-hearth furnace documents use flue gas to preheat combustion air, with temperature measurement at the exchanger's flue-gas outlet and a cold-air pipe at its inlet. Distinguish preheating performance, protective actions and furnace-pressure regulation. Combustion-air temperature is not a measured energy-saving result.
